---
title: "Continuing education"
---

Practical education helps coaches and performance staff interpret baserunning information and connect it to their own teaching and player-development work.

| Service | Included scope |
|---|---|
| E01 Staff workshop | One 3-hour remote workshop for up to 12 staff; workbook, case exercise and preparation call. |
| E02 Open seminar | One 90-minute live event with questions and practical examples; minimum 8 paid seats and maximum 30. |
| E03 Applied course | Six weekly 90-minute sessions, workbook, case assignment and feedback; 6–12 paid participants per cohort. |
| E04 Continuing staff education | Four quarterly 90-minute sessions, four case exercises and feedback for up to 12 named staff over one year. |

## Topics and application

Topics may include linear and curvilinear running demands, collecting comparable measurements, segment-specific interpretation, translating findings into development priorities and evaluating change. The agreed workshop or cohort description specifies the learning objectives.

## Completion and enrolment

These are professional-development activities. Attendance acknowledgements and course completion certificates do not confer accredited continuing-education credits, a regulated qualification or permission to certify others.

Open seminars and courses are scheduled subject to enrolment. We confirm the dates, minimum cohort and payment terms before booking; if the minimum is not reached, you may choose a replacement date or refund under the agreement. No live cohort dates are currently listed here.

Course materials are for participants’ learning and internal application. Recording or commercial redistribution requires separate permission. The annual staff programme does not include unlimited consultancy.

Request a tailored quote for your scope, location and schedule. [Enquire about staff education or a future cohort](contact.qmd).
